speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to Dr. Agent's office. I see you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; to better understand your condition, can you tell me exactly how many days postpartum you are?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count (CBC)
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis_and_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: I have ordered a Complete Blood Count and Urinalysis; while we wait for those results, have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge or any pain when urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
You mentioned decreased bowel sounds and uterine tenderness; have you noticed any abdominal distension, and is the uterus firm or boggy to the touch?

REQUEST TEST: Uterine_Sound_Check
REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for confirming the uterine assessment; while we wait for the ultrasound and lab results, have you experienced any leakage of gas or stool from the vagina, or any difficulty passing urine?

REQUEST TEST: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis_with_contrast
REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text:
Has the prolonged labor involved a rupture of membranes, and do you have any known history of pelvic inflammatory disease or recent instrumentation of the urinary tract?

REQUEST TEST: CRP (C-Reactive Protein)
REQUEST TEST: Vaginal_Swab_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on your history of prolonged labor and the decreased bowel sounds you mentioned earlier, have you noticed any signs of gas or stool passing through your vagina, or do you have any difficulty voiding?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Enterocutaneous Fistula / Urogenital Fistula (Clinical suspicion based on prolonged labor, decreased bowel sounds, and suspicion of rectal/urethral rupture requiring immediate imaging confirmation).

REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis_with_contrast (Awaiting results to confirm fistula location and extent).
